I. INTRODUCTION 

THIS MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING (“Memorandum”), executed on this date between BEDFORD PARK POLICE DEPARTMENT; hereafter referred to as “DEPARTMENT” and you and your PARTNER organization with its principal address indicated within the Registry portal, hereafter referred to as “PARTNER”; collectively referred to as “THE PARTIES.”

 

II. PREAMBLES

WHEREAS, Department is a law enforcement organization responsible for the preservation of safety and security in the geographic area in which the Department has jurisdiction. 

WHEREAS, Partner is a resident or organization operating within the jurisdiction of Department.​ 

WHEREAS, this Agreement has as its objective the collaboration and participation of both organizations for the safety and security of those who are at Partner’s location(s),  and for this reason this Agreement facilitates the establishment of channels of communication and sharing of video sources that permit the creation and interchange of information, as well as collaboration with the expressed goal of providing enhanced responsiveness and situational awareness for Department on behalf of Partner. 

WHEREAS, the missions of the Parties are complementary;

THEREFORE, the Parties wish to work together and in compliance with the following clauses:

  

III.  GOAL 

The goal of this agreement is to set forth guidelines for the registering of Partner’s video sources with the Department.

 

 IV. PURPOSE 

Camera registration is granted by Partner to video sources designated by Partner that are owned by or under management by Partner.  Cameras registered must also be approved by Department as appropriate for registering and deemed useful for purposes of enhanced situational awareness and safety of Partner and areas surrounding Partner’s location(s).  Camera registering by Partner with Department is intended to be done in the spirit of partnership for improved situational awareness and efficiency of emergency response by Department.  Camera registry does not constitute a commitment on the part of Department that video will be requested in emergencies.  

 

 V.  RESPONSIBILITIES OF DEPARTMENT 

Camera registry enables Department to know a camera is present at Partner’s location. Camera registry does not allow Department to access any of Partner’s live video streams. Department will not share access to Partner’s camera registry with members of the public, or outside of Department, without the prior written consent of Partner.  Further, Department will ensure camera registry is strictly limited to personnel authorized to access the camera registry, and authorized login metadata will be tracked and logged.  Finally, Department will ensure any employee authorized to access camera registry is trained on system use and security of access.  

 

 

VI. RESPONSIBILITIES OF PARTNER 

Partner will provide Department with at least one point of contact with a basic understanding of Partner’s inventory and locations of surveillance cameras as may be required for camera registry. Partner will also provide Department with the residential or business name and address as well as the number of internal and/or external cameras.     

  

VII. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY 

IN NO EVENT WILL EITHER PARTY BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, EXEMPLARY, PUNITIVE OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES OF ANY KIND, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO LOST REVENUES, PROFITS, OR GOODWILL, FOR ANY MATTER ARISING OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE PERFORMANCE OR NONPERFORMANCE OF THIS AGREEMENT.

 

VIII.  EFFECTIVE DATES AND AMENDMENTS. 

This MOU shall take effect upon signing by both Parties and shall remain in effect for a period of five (5) years from that date unless earlier terminated.  Neither party may assign or transfer all or any portion of this MOU without the prior written consent of the other party.  

The MOU may be renewed at the end of this period by mutual written agreement by both Parties.  

The provisions of this MOU may only be amended or waived by mutual written agreement by both Parties. 

Any Party may terminate this MOU and any related agreement at any time and for any reason by giving written notice to the other Party.

 

The individuals signing this MOU on behalf of their respective entities represent and warrant (without personal liability therefor) that upon the signature of each, this MOU shall have been duly executed by the entity each represents.

 

ENTIRETY

This Agreement, including all Annexes, embodies the entire and complete understanding and agreement between the Parties and no amendment will be effective unless signed by both Parties.
